candidate_relations.label: Pleural Empyema, right lower lung lobe
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms right-sided pleural empyema (positive cultures of lung fluid, CT showing massive pleural effusion resolving after treatment), but the benchmark requires specification of Edwardsiella tarda as the causative organism. The patient's raw fish consumption is the epidemiological clue pointing to this pathogen. C001 names only the anatomical/pathological entity without the etiologic component, making it a partial match.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the anatomical empyema component but omits the Edwardsiella tarda etiology required by the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Edwardsiella tarda etiology strongly supported by raw fish dietary history and positive cultures in an immunocompromised cirrhotic host, but culture organism not explicitly named in the record text
